This code goes through steps for processing/tidying FFI export data into clean, "tidy", dataframe for downstream analysis

1. Cover
2. Seedlings
3. Shrubs
4. Fuels report
5. Trees
6. Trees Report
7. Burn Severity Report


0. Load Libraries and functions & set working directory:
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(readr)

# Data Functions for loading raw FFI output data
# Header loading function
load_headers <- function(directory_path, pattern) {
  list_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  data_list <- lapply(list_files, function(file) {
    file_data <- read.csv(file) %>% select(1:10) %>% filter(Visited == "True")
    file_data <- file_data %>% mutate(Comment = "")
  })
  return(do.call(rbind, data_list))
}

load_data <- function(directory_path, pattern) {
  list_files <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  data_list <- lapply(list_files, function(file) {
    if (file.info(file)$size == 0) return(NULL)
    file_data <- tryCatch({
      read.csv(file, skip = 3) %>% mutate(Comment = "")
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Error reading file: ", file, " - skipping this file.")
      return(NULL)
    })
    return(file_data)
  })
  do.call(rbind, data_list[!sapply(data_list, is.null)])
}
  
directory_path <- "Data - Working/BMrx/"


```

1. Cover 
```{r}
cover_df <- load_data(directory_path, "_Cover - Points \\(metric\\)\\.csv$")
list <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "_Cover - Points \\(metric\\)\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)   
cover_headers <- lapply(list, function(file) read.csv(file, nrows = 1))
cover_headers <- do.call(rbind, cover_headers)  
cover_df <- left_join(x = cover_df, y = cover_headers, by = c("MacroPlot.Name", "Sample.Event.Date")) 
#to see unique plot names, type in "unique(Xdf$MacroPlot.Name) into console
cover_df <- cover_df %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:01" ~ "PIPS_01", 
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:02" ~ "PIPS_02",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:05" ~ "PIPS_05",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:14" ~ "PIPS_14", TRUE ~ MacroPlot.Name))%>%select(-MacroPlot.Name) 
cover_df <- cover_df %>% mutate(PlotStatus = case_when(startsWith(Sample.Event.Date, "2025") ~ "PreBurn",
                                                       startsWith(Sample.Event.Date, "2026") ~ "Year01", TRUE ~ NA_character_))
cover_df <- cover_df %>% select(c(Plot, PlotStatus, Tape, Transect, Point, Order, Species, Height, Status, Comment.x, Num..Transects, Tran..Length))

  
write.csv(cover_df, "Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/fall25rx_pre_year01_COVER.csv")  


```

2. Seedlings
```{r}
seedling_df <- load_data(directory_path, "_Density - Quadrats \\(metric\\)\\.csv$")
list <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "_Density - Quadrats \\(metric\\)\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
seedling_headers <- lapply(list, function(file) read.csv(file, nrows = 1))
seedling_headers <- do.call(rbind, seedling_headers)  
seedling_df <- left_join(x = seedling_df, y = seedling_headers, by = c("MacroPlot.Name", "Sample.Event.Date"))
seedling_df <- seedling_df %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:01" ~ "PIPS_01", 
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:02" ~ "PIPS_02",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:05" ~ "PIPS_05",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:14" ~ "PIPS_14", TRUE ~ MacroPlot.Name))%>%select(-MacroPlot.Name) 
seedling_df <- seedling_df %>% mutate(PlotStatus = case_when(startsWith(Sample.Event.Date, "2025") ~ "PreBurn",
                                                       startsWith(Sample.Event.Date, "2026") ~ "Year01", TRUE ~ NA_character_))

seedling_df <- seedling_df %>% select(c(Plot, PlotStatus, Quadrat, Item.Code, Status, Height, Count, Comment.x, Num..Quad..Tran., Quad..Length, Quad..Width, Quad..Area))

write.csv(seedling_df, "Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/fall25rx_pre_year01_SEEDLING.csv")

```

3. Shrub
```{r}
shrub_df <- load_data(directory_path, "_Density - Belts \\(metric\\)\\.csv$")
list <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "_Density - Belts \\(metric\\)\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
shrub_headers <- lapply(list, function(file) read.csv(file, nrows = 1))
shrub_headers <- do.call(rbind, shrub_headers)  
shrub_df <- left_join(x = shrub_df, y = shrub_headers, by = c("MacroPlot.Name", "Sample.Event.Date")) 

shrub_df <- shrub_df %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:01" ~ "PIPS_01", 
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:02" ~ "PIPS_02",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:05" ~ "PIPS_05",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:14" ~ "PIPS_14", TRUE ~ MacroPlot.Name))%>%select(-MacroPlot.Name) 
shrub_df <- shrub_df %>% mutate(PlotStatus = case_when(startsWith(Sample.Event.Date, "2025") ~ "PreBurn",
                                                       startsWith(Sample.Event.Date, "2026") ~ "Year01",TRUE ~ NA_character_))

shrub_df <- shrub_df %>% select(c(Plot, PlotStatus, Transect, Subbelt, Item.Code, Status, UV1, Count, Num..Transects, Num..Subbelts, Tran..Length, Tran..Width, Tran..Area)) %>% rename(HeightClass.m = UV1)

write.csv(shrub_df, "Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/fall25rx_pre_year01_SHRUB.csv")


```

4. Fuels
```{r}

fuels_report <- read.csv("Data - Working/BMrx//Report_SurfaceFuels_E.csv", skip = 2)
fuels_report <- fuels_report %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:01" ~ "PIPS_01", 
                                                 Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:02" ~ "PIPS_02",
                                                 Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:05" ~ "PIPS_05",
                                                 Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:14" ~ "PIPS_14", TRUE ~ Macroplot ))%>%select(-Macroplot) 

fuels_report <- fuels_report %>% select(c(Plot, MonStatus, OneHr, TenHr, HunHr, FineWood, X.3_Snd, X.3_Rot, TotalWood, Duff, Litter, TotalAll, DuffDep, LittDep, TotDep))

fuels_report <- fuels_report %>% slice(c(1:14, 25:27, 38:40, 52:54, 66:68))

fuels_report <- fuels_report %>% mutate(PlotStatus = case_when(MonStatus == "02PRE" | MonStatus == "01PRE" ~ "PreBurn", MonStatus == "03POST" | MonStatus == "02POST" ~ "PostBurn", MonStatus == "03YR01" | MonStatus == "02YR01" ~ "Year01"))

fuels_report <- fuels_report %>% select(c(Plot, PlotStatus, OneHr, TenHr, HunHr, FineWood, X.3_Snd, X.3_Rot, TotalWood, Duff, Litter, TotalAll, DuffDep, LittDep, TotDep))

write.csv(fuels_report, "Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/fall25rx_pre_post_year01_FUELS.csv")


```

5. Trees
```{r}
trees_df <- load_data(directory_path, "_Trees - Individuals \\(metric\\)\\.csv$")
list <- list.files(path = directory_path, pattern = "_Trees - Individuals \\(metric\\)\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) 
trees_headers <- lapply(list, function(file) read.csv(file, nrows = 1))
trees_headers <- do.call(rbind, trees_headers)  
trees_df <- left_join(x = trees_df, y = trees_headers, by = c("MacroPlot.Name", "Sample.Event.Date"))

trees_df <- trees_df %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:01" ~ "PIPS_01", 
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:02" ~ "PIPS_02",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:05" ~ "PIPS_05",
                                                 MacroPlot.Name == "FPIPS1T02:14" ~ "PIPS_14", TRUE ~ MacroPlot.Name))%>%select(-MacroPlot.Name) 
trees_df <- trees_df %>% mutate(PlotStatus = case_when(
  Sample.Event.Date == "2025/07/30" | Sample.Event.Date == "2025/07/31" ~ "PreBurn",
  Sample.Event.Date == "2025/11/20" | Sample.Event.Date == "2025/11/21" ~ "PostBurn",
  Sample.Event.Date == "2026/07/16" | Sample.Event.Date == "2026/06/17" | Sample.Event.Date == "2026/06/19" | Sample.Event.Date == "2026/07/16" |Sample.Event.Date == "2026/07/15" ~ "Year01"))
                                
                                
                                

trees_df <- trees_df %>% select(c(Plot, PlotStatus, Quarter, Tag.Num., Species, Status, Crown.Class, DBH, Height, Live.Crown.Base.Ht., Damage.1, Damage.2, Char.Ht., Scorch.Ht., Crown.Scorch.., Plot.Area, Break.Pnt..Dia.))

write.csv(trees_df, "Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/fall25rx_pre_post_year01_TREES.csv")


```

6. Trees Report
```{r}
trees_report <- read.csv("Data - Working/BMrx//Report_TreesbySpecies_E.csv", skip = 2)
trees_report <- trees_report %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:01" ~ "PIPS_01", 
                                                 Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:02" ~ "PIPS_02",
                                                 Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:05" ~ "PIPS_05",
                                                 Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:14" ~ "PIPS_14", TRUE ~ Macroplot ))%>%select(-Macroplot)

trees_report <- trees_report %>% select(c(Plot, MonStatus, Species, Individuals, Snag, Total, BA, LiCrBHt, Height, QMD, CrScPct, ScorchHt,CharHt))

trees_report <- trees_report %>% slice(c(1:14, 32:34, 45:47, 58:60))

trees_report <- trees_report %>% mutate(PlotStatus = case_when(MonStatus == "02PRE" | MonStatus == "01PRE" ~ "PreBurn", MonStatus == "03POST" | MonStatus == "02POST" ~ "PostBurn", MonStatus == "03YR01" | MonStatus == "02YR01" ~ "Year01"))

trees_report <- trees_report %>% select(c(Plot, PlotStatus, Species, Individuals, Snag, Total, BA, LiCrBHt, Height, QMD, CrScPct, ScorchHt,CharHt))

write.csv(trees_report, "Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/fall25rx_pre_post_year01_TREESREPORT.csv")

```

7. Burn Severity Report
```{r}
bs_report <- read.csv("Data - Working/BMrx//Report_PostBurnSeverity.csv")
bs_report <- bs_report %>% mutate(Plot = case_when(Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:01" ~ "PIPS_01", 
                                                 Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:02" ~ "PIPS_02",
                                                 Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:05" ~ "PIPS_05",
                                                 Macroplot == "FPIPS1T02:14" ~ "PIPS_14", TRUE ~ Macroplot ))%>%select(-Macroplot) 
bs_report <- bs_report %>% slice(c(3,6,9,11))
bs_report <- bs_report %>% mutate(PlotStatus = "PostBurn")
bs_report <- bs_report %>% select(c(Plot, PlotStatus, 3:14))

write.csv(bs_report, "Data - Working/FFI_Data_Clean/Fall25rx/fall25rx_post_BURNSEVERITY.csv")

```
